senses.gloss: f. pl.(b. h.; הרף, cmp. חָרַף)grits, polenta.
units: Sot. 42ᵇ (homiletical play on Harafah, II Sam. XXI, 16, a. Orpah, Ruth I, 4) why was she called Harafah? שהכל דשין אותה כה׳ because all pounded (used) her like grits, v. דּוּשׁ. [Cmp.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 1:1:32">Y. Kidd. I, 59ᵃ</cite> top a.

<cite ref="Keritot 11a:45">Kerith. 11ᵃ</cite> where <he>חרף</he> is taken as the equivalent of <he>כתש</he>, with reference to <cite ref="E00867"><he>הריפות</he></cite> <cite ref="Proverbs 27:22">Prov. XXVII, 22</cite>. Cmp. <cite ref="E00547"><he>הַלְטָאָה</he></cite> for obliteration of radical <cite ref="E00000"><he>ה</he></cite>.—

<cite ref="Targum of I Chronicles 20:4">Targ. I Chr. XX, 4</cite>; <cite ref="Targum of I Chronicles 20:6">6</cite>; <cite ref="Targum of I Chronicles 20:8">8</cite> reads <cite ref="P01433"><he>ערפה</he></cite> for h. text <he>הרפאים</he>, <cite ref="T00943"><he>הרפא</he></cite>.]
